metadata.title: JamFinds — Live BeamNG Mods from Reddit, BeamFinds & BeamFree
metadata.description: Live BeamNG mods auto-synced from 4 subreddits + BeamFinds + BeamFree, with decoded download links.

header.refreshTitle: Force sync from all sources now

hero.body: JamFinds watches four subreddits and two mod sites around the clock — r/Beamng_Jamaica, r/BeamNGpiratemods, r/beamng_leakedmods, r/BeamNG_Leaked_M0ds, BeamFinds and BeamFree — and pulls each new release the moment it appears. Base64 mod codes from Reddit are decoded automatically: no decoder sites, no hunting.

footer.tagline: JamFinds — unofficial live index of BeamNG.drive mods
footer.disclaimer: Not affiliated with Reddit, BeamNG GmbH, BeamFinds, BeamFree, or any subreddit staff. All mods are created and shared by their respective communities; JamFinds only indexes public posts and decodes the links they already contain. Use modded files at your own risk and scan downloads before installing.
